This policy version 2.0 (DOC0101, effective 2026-09-01) supersedes DOC0005 v1.0. Employees may work from a company office in another country for up to 21 consecutive days (reduced from 30 days in v1.0). Under version 2.0 (DOC0101), a request to work from another country (INTL_WORK) must be submitted at least 15 business days in advance of the start date (increased from 10 business days in DOC0005 v1.0). The request must state the destination country, the local office, the start and end dates, and the business reason.

According to the latest International Work Policy (DOC0101 v2.0, effective 2026-09-01):
1. An employee can work from another country for a maximum of **21 consecutive days** [DOC0101].
